## Use case

Who needs this behavior and what task is currently difficult?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the expected inputs, outputs and permissions. Include a small example.

## Alternatives

What can you do today, and why is it insufficient?

## Scope and verification

Which UI/API/storage areas would change? How could a contributor verify success? Check ROADMAP.md before proposing a new item. A feature request is not a commitment to implement it.
